sampling: Fresh FB per scenario. Each trace row supplies all inputs, invoke once, then check expected outputs. Missing expected keys are not scored.
execution_status: Data/specification checks only. No candidate ST compilation, execution or formal proof in this delivery.
format_note: Standalone data, not plc-task-v1 and not a direct arbitrary-JSON input to existing CLI. adapter_format identifies the existing native representation.
boolean_note: BOOL trace fields use JSON booleans; positional native adapter rows retain existing 0/1 transport.
array_note: Native bank traces flatten fixed-array elements with their actual indices. Custom traces keep JSON arrays, first element = declared lower bound.
time_note: Public TIME/LTIME transported in milliseconds. No scans are implicitly executed between timestamps.
